fixedRouteAuthority: Jerami selected Figma for Team callout and Unreal for the two paired-logo options, October 21, 2026. Pending review is not production approval.
retirementAuthority: Jerami moved new LineUps builds from Unreal to Figma or Blender on November 10, 2026. Unreal sources, exports and approvals stay as history. Options without a current source ask Figma or Blender.
blenderVariantRule: A Blender variant is one swappable template, like a Figma component variant: a Blender CLI builder plus a per-player or per-episode data file. Cue frames are absolute at 25 fps from the spoken cues, so a new edit changes only the data. IDs are the lane number plus a letter (3A, 3B, 4A); add letters as lanes gain variants. Only status "approved" with approvedBy Jerami and an approvalSource can route a build. Jev may suggest a variant; it never binds one.
